proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule XVII, Section 1701, what is the minimum steel gauge required for the walls and structure of a paint spray booth, and what is the maximum permitted floor area of the booth?

options.text: No. 18 U.S. gauge minimum; booth area ≤ 150 sq.m AND ≤ 10% of the basic permitted area for the building's Occupancy Group
No. 20 U.S. gauge minimum; booth area ≤ 200 sq.m, which allows for larger installations but may not meet all safety standards
No. 18 U.S. gauge minimum; booth area ≤ 150 sq.m only, ensuring compliance with standard safety regulations
No. 16 U.S. gauge minimum; booth area ≤ 80 sq.m, which is more restrictive but may enhance structural integrity
